explanation: seoPages.mts no longer imports the deleted seoTopics module, so a study page has no topic panel and a dataset change no longer has curated topic memberships to keep in step. Study pages, the directory and the sitemap still derive from the registry, so the dataset-change procedure is unchanged. From main, only the transport of pnpm run fetch:data changes (authenticated GitHub releases API); the archives and hashes pinned in data-release.json are unchanged.
